tooltip.essentialcraft5.blank_module.en: Base for the six Computer Guy's Suit modules; does nothing by itself
tooltip.essentialcraft5.blank_module.zh: 六块宅男套装模块的底料，本身没有效果

tooltip.essentialcraft5.module.how.en: Install it by crafting it together with a piece of the Computer Guy's Suit; switch it or take it out in the Computer Terminal
tooltip.essentialcraft5.module.how.zh: 在工作台里和一件宅男盔甲放在一起就能装上；在宅男终端里开关、拆下

tooltip.essentialcraft5.module.disabled.en: Disabled by the server: cannot be installed, and does nothing if already installed
tooltip.essentialcraft5.module.disabled.zh: 已被服务器禁用：装不上，已经装着的不生效

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Wear all four pieces to run modules
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 没穿齐四件：模块都不生效
穿齐了四件：模块按下面的状态生效
穿着的每件上的模块各自生效

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Craft a module with a suit piece to fit it
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 在工作台里把模块和一件宅男盔甲放在一起就能装上

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Take this module out into your inventory (dropped at your feet if it is full)
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 拆下这块模块放回背包（背包满了掉在脚下）

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Unknown module: removing it gives nothing back
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 认不出的模块：拆下以后什么都不会还给你

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Use the switch on the right to turn it on
Not enough MRU on you: this second's upkeep could not be paid, or there is not enough for one use
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 身上的 MRU 不够：这一秒的电费没付起，或者不够触发一次

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Modules only work while all four suit pieces are worn
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 要穿齐四件宅男盔甲，模块才生效

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: This module is disabled in this world: it does nothing and uses no MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 这个世界里停用了这块模块：装着不生效、不耗电

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Only one module of each kind counts; another one is already working
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 同种模块全套只算一块，另一块已经在生效

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: This piece has fewer slots than modules, so this one does not work; take it out and install it elsewhere
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 这件的模块槽比装着的少，排在后面的这块不生效；拆下来装到别处

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: This module is not recognised (it may no longer exist)
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 认不出这块模块（可能已经不存在了）

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.en: Just switched on or installed: it starts working once this second's upkeep is paid, within a second
gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: 刚打开或刚装上：这一秒的电费扣成以后才开始起作用，最多等 1 秒
